title: 2026-11-27 — A suggested reference is thumbed up or binned (Greenman)

sections.name: greenman-1
sections.label: Greenman — 2026-11-27
sections.content: What does keep do? Can we just make an x style small icon that removes the suggestion? Or allow a thumbs up or thumbs down? The buttons are big, and take too much space. The link is already there, so keep seems irrelevant

sections.name: greenman-2
sections.label: Greenman — 2026-11-27
sections.content: Lets thumb up or bin.   Otherwise there are too many irrelevant ux elements

sections.name: context
sections.content: Said about the References panel's Keep / Deny buttons on an agent's suggested reference (srs-web#787, PR #839). Keep only recorded an `agree` response and Deny a `disagree` one; neither changed a link, so a denied reference stayed linked. Ruling for the editor: one small thumb up to affirm, and a bin that removes the suggestion; no separate deny.
